text:
alana: Tiny celebratory post — huge thanks to @samir and @maria for stepping in on the staging storage flakiness yesterday. demo saved and client call stayed calm ❤

samir: no way I would've figured out the object lease race without Maria's hint. team win :tada:

maria: we hacked a quick eviction check + log. filed a follow-up ticket to clean it properly. added notes in the runbook.

devin: seriously impressed. also, samir brought cookies to the on-call room at 1am, which is a health hazard in the best way. :cookie: :heart_eyes:

lee: can we give them a little physical token? i found a box of tiny acrylic trophies in the office closet that say "micro-savior" 😂

jules: vote: trophy or bagel? react with :trophy: or :bagel:

ops-bot: Reminder: automated snapshot completed at 23:45 UTC for staging (ID: s-snap-20260322).

alana: love the trophy idea. i'll put one on each desk and a note. also ordering a small bagel pack for tomorrow's stand.

samir: really appreciate that — not necessary but made my week 🙂

maria: same. also pushing the follow-up PR today, will tag everyone for review.

devin: +1 on the bagels. and can we put a tiny sticky on the runbook entry that says who rescued it? little shoutouts live forever.

lee: added the runbook sticky. and jules counted reactions: 6 trophies, 3 bagels, 2 heart emojis. we are clearly a mixed snack culture.

jules: passing along appreciation to the rest of the infra folks who helped triage. team ripple effect 👋

alana: big thanks again. tiny trophies and carbs incoming. if anyone wants to add a one-line shoutout to the runbook note, reply here and i'll paste it in. :sparkles:
